authority_note: This checkpoint does not modify companies/APP/latest.json or current registry authority. Current canonical authority remains the 2026-09-06 preliminary review until a separate canonical harness run promotes it.
review_method: User-supplied Q2 2026 earnings 8-K/Exhibit 99.1, 2026 definitive proxy, proxy additional materials, five Form 4 filings and one Form 144 were structured and cross-checked as a non-current research checkpoint. One additional supplied file was entirely zero bytes and was excluded as unreadable.
portfolio_context: No synchronized current quote, tax basis, position size, or portfolio risk budget was supplied. This is not a buy approval or automatic portfolio action.
structural_thesis: AppLovin is showing exceptional operating leverage after concentrating on its core advertising platform: Q2 2026 revenue grew more than 50%, GAAP operating margin approached 78%, company-defined FCF margin was about 45%, SBC remained below 5% of revenue and diluted share count fell year over year. The central question is whether Axon-driven advertiser performance and e-commerce expansion are durable and independently verifiable rather than a transient optimization cycle that the current market price may already fully discount.
customer_and_moat: The supplied filings show extraordinary revenue and margin acceleration, plus management's continued emphasis on Axon AI and early web/e-commerce expansion. However, the package does not establish independent advertiser ROAS, customer retention/cohorts, traffic quality, customer concentration or platform-policy dependency, so the economic moat is not treated as fully verified.
current_finding: Q2 2026 revenue was $1.924B, up about 53% YoY, operating income was $1.494B and company FCF was $863M. H1 revenue grew about 56%, net income about 77% and operating cash flow about 35%. H1 SBC was only about 4.5% of revenue while weighted-average diluted shares declined about 1.6% YoY and ending share count fell about 0.9% from year-end despite continued equity compensation.
economic_finding: The supplied interim tables point to unusually strong per-share economics: the business is highly asset-light, repurchases exceeded $1.5B in H1, dilution was more than offset, and net debt was only about $462M against annualized H1 adjusted EBITDA above $6B. The weaker point is that Q2 FCF grew only about 12% despite revenue growth above 50%, so working-capital and tax timing need a full 10-Q/10-K bridge before normalized owner FCF growth is finalized.
capital_and_survival: Liquidity and debt service appear strong from the supplied interim balance sheet and cash-flow data: cash was about $3.05B against $3.52B long-term debt, with very high operating cash generation. Survival is not the principal issue. Capital allocation quality depends on whether large repurchases were executed below intrinsic value and whether governance concentration protects or impairs minority-owner economics.
next_evidence: Readable FY2025 10-K and Q2 2026 10-Q; synchronized current quote and 9% reverse DCF; independent advertiser ROAS/retention evidence; customer and platform concentration; eight-quarter gross issuance/withholding/repurchase/share bridge; repurchase price versus intrinsic value; legal/regulatory and traffic-quality verification.
permanent_loss_case: Operating results can remain excellent while shareholders still suffer permanent loss if Axon performance proves less durable than implied, dependence on external platforms or traffic quality causes a structural reset, voting control weakens minority-owner protections, or the stock price already embeds years of exceptional growth and 80%+ adjusted EBITDA margins.
falsifiers: Revenue growth decelerates sharply while GAAP operating margin and advertiser monetization weaken at the same time.
Independent evidence shows advertiser ROAS, retention or traffic quality deteriorating materially despite reported revenue growth.
Net share count turns persistently positive because SBC or acquisition issuance outpaces economically sensible repurchases.
A full 10-K/10-Q review reveals material accounting, customer-concentration, platform-policy or legal risks not visible in the supplied earnings and proxy package.
increase_evidence: Independent advertiser ROAS and cohort retention confirm Axon creates durable incremental value across mobile gaming and newer e-commerce customers.
Owner FCF per share compounds while SBC remains near current low-single-digit revenue levels and net share count is flat to down without overpaying for repurchases.
Readable 10-K/10-Q evidence confirms strong controls, manageable customer/platform concentration and no hidden balance-sheet or legal dependence.
A 9% reverse DCF shows the current price requires assumptions below a defensible Base case.
sell_evidence: Material deterioration in advertiser economics or traffic quality together with decelerating revenue and margin compression.
Large value-destructive repurchases undertaken at prices requiring an unrealistic bull case while organic owner-cash growth slows.
Governance or related-party actions materially impair Class A minority-owner rights or capital allocation discipline.
